integrity: All 216 ordered frequency triples and all rational Hessian entries and eigenvalue multiplicities are reproducible with the bundled dependency-free checker. The proof supplies the infinite local conclusion through the exact polynomial identity and Taylor expansion; numerical perturbations alone are not proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact local moment Hessian and sharp infinitesimal distance deficit only. No global six-mode Fourier-extension constant or global extremizer classification is claimed; results pertain to one fixed six-frequency hexagon. Independent validation has not been performed.
title: Exact transverse sixth-moment stability for the hexagonal Fourier aperture
